Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg LTD (TSM) Market Valuation Rose While Origin Asset Management Llp Has Trimmed by $3.12 Million Its Position May 12, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Origin Asset Management Llp decreased its stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd (TSM) by 4.82% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Origin Asset Management Llp sold 80,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.24% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.58 million shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $62.63 million, down from 1.66M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Origin Asset Management Llp who had been investing in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $202.98B market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.14 $39.91. About 4.18M shares traded. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 30.51% uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.96% the S&P500.
Origin Asset Management Llp, which manages about $2.70B and $1.75 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 116,800 shares to 279,630 shares, valued at $47.32M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Mgic Invt Corp Wis (NYSE:MTG) by 874,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 900,632 shares, and has risen its stake in Thor Inds Inc (NYSE:THO).
